assessmentSummary.identity: One 90/90 Hip Switch cycle starts seated in a controlled bent-knee 90/90 position, transitions both legs to the opposite 90/90 side through a comfortable hip-rotation range, then returns under control without rising. Optional hands behind the body support the base but do not change the no-rise identity. This is not a shin-box get-up, walking task, lunge, kick, assessment, or run.
currentCardFindings: Source 54 omits a cycle boundary, hand-support/elevation contract, range, fatigue, substitution, and review contract.
Shin Box Get-Up adds a rise and is a new definition; no-hands lift-off changes the support/base contract and is a new variant.
Five oEmbed candidates are recorded without playback, exact-match, accessibility, quality, or approval claims.

currentCardSnapshot.description: On a clear stable floor or mat, sit in a comfortable bent-knee 90/90 position with optional light hands behind the body. Transition both legs under control to the opposite 90/90 side through the available hip-rotation range, then return without rising. One cycle is left 90/90 to right 90/90 and back. This excludes a shin-box get-up, walking, lunge, kick, assessment, and forced end range.
